title: Master Program in Geospatial Technologies
institution: University of Münster, Universitat Jaume I and NOVA IMS (Erasmus Mundus Master in Geospatial Technologies)
about: Erasmus Mundus scholarship applications for the joint MSc in Geospatial Technologies (University of Münster, Universitat Jaume I in Castellón, NOVA IMS in Lisbon), taught in English and starting September 2027, are due January 7, 2027.
requirements: Adequate Bachelor degree of six semesters full time (180 ECTS) or more
Partner-country applicants must have finished their first degree by the deadline
